messages:
samir: Hey team — first on-call rotation is next week. Two quick asks: I can’t find the shadow checklist in the repo (link in runbooks 404s for me), and I haven’t been added to PagerDuty. Who should I ping for access?

claire: Welcome @samir! I pushed a slimmed-down checklist last week, might be under docs/oncall/quick-start.md now. I’ll paste a one-paragraph version below. Also I added you to PD just now, check email.

claire: Quick-start (copy):
1) Accept PD invite, enable mobile + do a low-priority test page.
2) Confirm read-only runbooks + vault access.
3) Run the dev-reenact script to see alert flow.
4) Join a 30m sim and shadow a buddy for first live page.

jen: Sim signup is here: https://go/rw-oncall-sims — pick a slot and add your GitHub handle. If PD invite doesn’t arrive in 10m, reply here and @claire or I will resend.

devops-bot: Reminder: do NOT use production credentials during sims. Use the dev namespace keys: dev-shadow-key (read-only).

samir: Thanks! One more thing — if I get a page during a shadow and I’m unsure, what’s the short escalation pattern so I don’t flail? Bullet TL;DR appreciated.

claire: Escalation TL;DR we tell newbies: 
- 0-10m: Ack in PD and post a 1-2 line context in #incidents. Start a running doc with timeline.
- 10-25m: If not making progress, add the secondary on PD and ping @oncall-ops in-channel. Ask for pair help.
- 25-45m: For customer-visible impact or P1, phone the on-call lead and spin up an incident channel from the template.
- After: assign a postmortem owner within 48h and tag infra for follow-ups.

oncall-ops: @samir scheduled for shadow-week starting 2026-09-14. Buddy assigned: claire. Sim slot reserved Tue 2026-09-15 13:00-13:45. Please complete the quick-start doc before the sim: https://go/rw-oncall-checklist

samir: Awesome — test page worked and I can see the runbook now. I’ll sign up for the sim and try the reenact tonight. Appreciate the fast help!
